== frame after_cd cursor=6,44
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ mkdir -p ancestor/.git
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ printf 'ref: refs/heads/ancestor-branch\n' > ancestor/.git/H
|EAD
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd ancestor/child
|testuser@<HOST> ~/a/child ancestor-branch $
